snippet.title: MOJO Party - World Premiere Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Spring 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
MOJO Party is the ultimate trivia and party game from the world's biggest pop culture ranking brand, WatchMojo! Test your knowledge across the iconic Top 10 lists that have entertained millions of fans worldwide, from the greatest movie villains and best video game bosses to the most iconic cartoon characters and unforgettable music moments. Compete with friends and family in a hilarious battle of pop culture supremacy, challenging each other to predict, rank, and debate the lists you know and love. Whether you're a hardcore WatchMojo superfan or just love a good party night, MOJO Party brings the countdown energy straight to your living room, because everyone's got an opinion, but only one player can take the top spot!

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45348822/sale/spring2026
